FACTS ESTABLISHED DURING IMPLEMENTATION (verified; include where relevant)
- Pipeline order in CaptureInterpretationOrchestrator.process: load capture (already has occurrence -> AlreadyHasOccurrence, nothing else happens) -> load ACTIVE catalog -> CandidateSelector (bound 40, context hash) -> ActivityInterpreter -> TemporalResolver on the model's temporal phrase -> InterpretationValidator -> repository write. Raw capture is persisted before this, by createRawCapture.
- Outcomes: AUTO_ACCEPT -> acceptInterpretation (one transaction, capture PERSISTED); NEEDS_REVIEW -> interpretation stored NEEDS_REVIEW, capture NEEDS_REVIEW, nothing logged; REJECT -> interpretation stored INVALID, capture NEEDS_REVIEW; interpreter MALFORMED/OTHER -> INVALID interpretation (operation UNSUPPORTED, resolution UNRESOLVED, reason INTERPRETER_OUTPUT_MALFORMED / INTERPRETER_FAILED), capture NEEDS_REVIEW; UNAVAILABLE/RETRYABLE -> no interpretation, capture FAILED_RETRYABLE.
- A stored interpretation's matched_activity_id is the model's id only if that id is in the catalog loaded for the run, otherwise null (it is a foreign key; an invented id must still reach review). The model's full answer is kept in structured_result_json; the validator judges the unmodified answer.
- validation_reason holds comma-joined, alphabetically sorted ValidationReason names (20 constants: 11 rejecting incl. the two interpreter-failure ones, 9 review). Names are persisted text.
- AUTO_ACCEPT requires HIGH confidence band; speech confidence below 0.5 (single constant) -> review. No "auto-accept with review marker" tier exists.
- Review resolution (ReviewResolutionService) inserts an interpretation with interpreter_version "user-resolution", prompt_version "none", schema_version 1, validation VALID, then accepts it; earlier interpretations untouched; default time = capture instant with INFERRED_NOW; refuses a capture that already has an occurrence.
- Correction (CorrectionService, source USER): refuses unknown or HIDDEN occurrence, missing or non-ACTIVE target, time after now, invalid new name, new name matching an ACTIVE activity's name or alias (returned with that activity id so the UI can offer it). New activity names are trimmed. A correction to a new activity creates it ACTIVE in the same transaction (LedgerWriteDao.applyCorrectionCreatingActivity). No interpretation row is created by a correction (DB1 rule unchanged).
- Data layer additions (no schema change, DB version 1): LedgerWriteDao.recordOutcome (interpretation insert + processing state, atomic; only NEEDS_REVIEW/FAILED_RETRYABLE/FAILED_FINAL; refused when an occurrence exists) and applyCorrectionCreatingActivity; accept/correct refuse a non-ACTIVE target activity. Public entry point for the app: createActivityRepository(context, clock).
- Known seam: an activity archived between catalog load and accept makes process() throw with nothing written; the caller (Step 4) must catch and rerun.
- Still open / deferred: hide/restore (Undo, "Remove from history") needs a data-layer operation and an audit decision (corrections has no visibility columns) — Step 7; listing captures waiting for review — Step 7; re-interpretation of an accepted capture (CorrectionSource.REINTERPRETATION) has no path yet; confidence thresholds beyond "HIGH only" and the 0.5 speech constant to be calibrated with the Step 5 corpus / Step 6 recognizer output.
